proof_origin.note: J2 proves all steps in Lean. Instead of selecting finitely many scaled generators, use their full power-root subalgebra. The conclusion requires integral, not finite, so finiteness is unnecessary. The scheme and its morphism are concrete; the field equivalence is determined by localization uniqueness.

title: Purely inseparable generic base spread
statement: Let S be an affine integral scheme in universe u with generic point eta. Let k-prime be a field in universe u equipped with a finite purely inseparable extension of kappa(eta). There exist an affine integral scheme S-prime, a universal homeomorphism q: S-prime to S, a generic point eta-prime with q(eta-prime)=eta, and a ring equivalence e: kappa(eta-prime) to k-prime. After identifying kappa(q(eta-prime)) with kappa(eta) using this equality, e composed with the residue field map induced by q equals the given algebra map into k-prime. The statement depends only on S and the specified field extension, and constructs no source-family field map.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_purely_inseparable_generic_base_spread
    {S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] [IsIntegral S]
    (η : S) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (k' : Type u) [Field k'] [Algebra (S.residueField η) k']
    [Module.Finite (S.residueField η) k'] [IsPurelyInseparable (S.residueField η) k'] :
    ∃ (S' : Scheme.{u}) (q : S' ⟶ S),
      IsAffine S' ∧ IsIntegral S' ∧ IsUniversalHomeomorphism q ∧
      ∃ (η' : S') (hq : q η' = η),
        IsGenericPoint η' Set.univ ∧
        ∃ e : S'.residueField η' ≃+* k',
          e.toRingHom.comp
            (((S.residueFieldCongr hq).inv ≫ q.residueFieldMap η').hom) =
              algebraMap (S.residueField η) k'
lean.note: 2026-10-20 (U): retired Sheaf twin Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.PurelyInseparableGenericBaseSpread; points at its upstream twin.

proof.text: Put A = Gamma(S, top) and K = kappa(eta), with the algebra structure given by evaluation. Mathlib identifies the generic stalk with Frac(A); its residue map is a field isomorphism, so kappa(eta) is also Frac(A). The proved private helper fraction_at_generic performs this transport.

Let p be the exponential characteristic of K and construct B = Subalgebra.perfectClosure A k-prime p. This is Mathlib's concrete subalgebra of elements whose p-power lies in the image of A, not an object chosen from an existence theorem. For x in k-prime choose n and y in K with x^(p^n)=y. Express y=a/d with d nonzero. Then (d*x)^(p^n)=d^(p^n-1)*a, so d*x is in B and x=(d*x)/d. Subtype inclusion is injective. IsFractionRing.of_field now proves k-prime is Frac(B). This is the proved private helper perfectClosure_fractionRing; p=1 covers characteristic zero and the argument requires no finiteness.

B is a domain as a subalgebra of the field k-prime. Each b in B has a positive p-power equal to the image of an element of A, so is integral by IsIntegral.of_pow. The algebra map A to B is injective since A embeds in K and K embeds in k-prime. Lying over proves Spec B to Spec A surjective. To prove universal injectivity, take two field-valued points agreeing on A. Their images of b have the same p-power. In prime characteristic that power is injective in the target field by iterateFrobenius_inj; when p=1 it is the identity, regardless of the target characteristic. The field-valued-point criterion proves universal injectivity. Combine integral, surjective, universally injective to obtain Algebra.IsUniversalHomeomorphism A B. All this is proved in perfectClosure_universalHomeomorphism.

Set S-prime=Spec B and q=Spec.map(algebraMap A B) followed by S.isoSpec.inv. It is affine and integral, and q is a universal homeomorphism by composition with the affine isomorphism. Let eta-prime be its generic point. The continuous surjection q takes its generic point to eta by uniqueness. Via Gamma(Spec B,top) congruent to B, both kappa(eta-prime) and k-prime are fraction fields of Gamma(Spec B,top). The localization algebra equivalence gives the required ring equivalence e. Check the residue-field compatibility on A using Gamma-evaluation naturality, the identity q.appTop followed by GammaSpecIso equals algebraMap A B, and e.commutes. IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext upgrades that identity on A to equality on K. The point equality transports evaluation by evaluation_congr_inv. No remaining proof holes or additional assumptions are used.
